source: Synchronization is another part of the cost model. If threads cooperate through shared memory, barriers such as __syncthreads() may be required for correctness. The data reuse benefit must therefore be weighed against storage pressure, bank-access behavior, and synchronization overhead.
zh: 同步是成本模型的另一部分。如果线程通过共享内存进行协作，则可能需要 __syncthreads() 等屏障来确保正确性。因此，必须权衡数据重用优势与存储压力、存储体访问行为和同步开销。
